# Context Memory Harness

> A local memory shared by AI assistants, with sources attached: Claude Code sessions, chats, code and documents in one store on the owner's laptop, retrieved over MCP from any machine through SSH. Open source (MIT).

This site serves Markdown to agents at the same URLs as the human pages. The live memory endpoints answer only from the public part of the project.

## Docs

- [Project overview](/index.md): pipeline stages, measured performance, endpoints
- [Replication guide](/guide.md): six commands with a check after each
- [Pipeline as JSON](/pipeline.json): stages, code locations, endpoints

## API

- [AG-UI agent](/api/agent): POST RunAgentInput, server-sent events; answers cite retrieved excerpts
- [Search](/api/search?q=disclosure%20gate): GET, JSON excerpts with sources and verification status
- [Stats](/api/stats): GET, live counts of the public memory

## Optional

- [Source repository](https://github.com/p-doshi/context-memory)
- [AG-UI protocol](https://docs.ag-ui.com)
